hero.title: Markdown to Word
hero.subtitle: Convert Markdown to Word with live preview and one-click download

intro: MD2Tool's Markdown to Word converter runs entirely in your browser: edit Markdown on the left, preview the result live, and download a DOCX file you can keep editing in Microsoft Word or WPS. Completely free with no sign-up, and your files are never uploaded.

faq.a: Headings, paragraphs, ordered and unordered lists, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, bold, italics, and links (GFM syntax) are all converted with matching Word styles.

faq.q: Can I keep editing the generated Word file?
faq.a: Yes. The DOCX output keeps heading levels, lists, and table structures, so it opens cleanly in Microsoft Word and WPS Office for further editing.

faq.q: Is my content uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser — your content never leaves your device.

faq.q: Are there file size or usage limits?
faq.a: No. The tool is completely free, with no file size or conversion limits.

faq.q: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a: No. Just open the page and start converting — no registration required.
